anchor_definition: The anchor is double_submit: the login submit handler whose body reads #pwd/#un, constructs a JSEncrypt, sets the public key, RSA-encrypts password (and username) inline, and assembles the credentials.* payload it posts. PLAN §4.3: the password ciphertext is constructed inline inside this function (no dedicated encrypt function), so this enclosing function is the anchor; PLAN §5.1: not the validation precondition it calls, a cookie util, or the JSEncrypt library primitive.

anchor.why: Builds the login request: new JSEncrypt + setPublicKey(pubkey), j=i.encrypt(password), then h={'credentials.password':j,...} which is posted to /publicPassport/login.do. This constructs the exact credentials.password value observed.

roles.why: Validation gate called by the submit handler before encryption (checks the account and password fields). On the path but does not construct the encrypted value.
A generic cookie reader utility; unrelated to the password encryption path.
